reference.reading: Folded B substitutes for the initial B; the following seven glyphs read lendLib.
reference.measurement: Ink x-runs from RGB max < 200, more than 8 pixels per column; integer bounding boxes with exclusive right/bottom edges.
reference.color_normalization: Average the two dark medians and the two fold medians, round .5 upward: graphite #292D31, fold #87898D.

font.outline_policy: Use the provided font unchanged. Shape lendLib with HarfBuzz, then extract its CFF glyph outlines with fontTools. No substituted font or synthetic bold.

user_decision: The user explicitly selected the folded B as the first letter and the font for lendLib, preserving the original composition.
